description:
Ask a question about Fidget Labs in plain language and get the pages that answer it:
services, engagements, industries, platforms, case studies, the pricing model, articles
and glossary terms. Each result has a name, a URL and a description.

Use this first when you do not know which page covers something, for example "can they
migrate us off Adobe Experience Manager" or "do they run paid media". Results are
retrieval over the site's own index, not generated text.

limit.description: How many pages to return, 1 to 25. Defaults to 8.
